about.copy: Ruth Hernica brings together her perspective as a biologist, her vocation, and her training as a massage therapist to offer attentive and professional support. Each session begins with listening to the body and to your needs in the moment.

Attention to detail and professional rigor developed through my professional experience.
Continuous training, constant learning, and integration of varied techniques.
